[1/2] scripts/project_publish.py + aikit publish <name> [--public]: needs a commit, full secret scan of the project, gh auth; creates the project's own private GitHub repo (gh repo create --source --remote origin --push) or pushes to its existing origin; unit tests with an injected runner; [2/2] P011 R8 names publish; docs; ADR-134

impact_assessment.why: projects live only on this disk; the user wants each in its own GitHub repository
impact_assessment.benefits: one command backs up and shares a project in its own repo, private unless asked, never with a credential in it
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new publish command; dependency: gh CLI (declared optional, checked at run time); concurrency: none; state: creates a remote repository, which is outward-facing
impact_assessment.mitigation: private by default, secret scan of every tracked file first, no force push, refusal triads; tests never call gh

impact_assessment.why: Complete GitHub repository lifecycle for projects: publish at creation, repo details, and auto-push on check
impact_assessment.benefits: One-step project publishing, GitHub description sync, URL visibility in status/list, and auto-push after passed gates
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new flags on new and check, status/list output additions; dependency: optional gh preserved; concurrency: none; state: project memory intact
impact_assessment.mitigation: Injected runner in tests to guarantee unit tier <1s and zero spawns; non-destructive publication and push failure fallbacks

[1/4] plan: harden project publishing, sanitize readme description, and add integration tests

impact_assessment.why: harden project publish lifecycle edge cases: empty repo push, upstream tracking initialization, badge/html pollution in readme description, and duplicate config options
impact_assessment.benefits: bulletproof publishing, zero unnecessary network pushes via upstream tracking, pristine GitHub repository descriptions, robust git config parsing, and end-to-end integration coverage
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: independent project directories; state: zero uncommitted state leaks
impact_assessment.mitigation: verify unit tests under strict _refuse_spawn, run integration tests under real subprocess execution, and pass all Phase 4 verification gates
